card.title: IPhone 12 Stuck In Recovery Mode After Water Damage Solution

source.title: IPhone 12 Stuck In Recovery Mode After Water Damage Solution

symptoms: stuck in recovery after water damage
update succeeds then back to recovery

claims.statement: Water near the iPhone 12 power button connector can damage the PMIC so it doesn't hold the button lines at 1.8 V; the phone thinks a button is held and boots into recovery or diagnostics.
Measure IO_BUTTON_SIDE_L_1V8_CONN and the volume lines with the phone on: 1.8 V is normal; around 0.6 V indicates the PMIC fault.
Data-recovery fix: jumper PP1V8_S2 to the stuck-low lines; permanent fix is PMIC replacement (split board). Don't restore if data matters.

procedure: Clean corrosion at the power button connector.
Boot and measure side and volume button lines (1.8 V).
Jumper PP1V8_S2 to low lines for data, or replace PMIC.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Restoring will lose customer data; updates are safe.
